strings.name: Masayoshi Son
strings.summary: Born to a Korean family in Saga, Son studied in the US before founding SoftBank. He moved from software distribution into telecoms and investment, backing Alibaba, acquiring Arm and establishing the Vision Fund. Large investments produced gains and substantial losses. Recent AI and data-center bets remain exposed to markets and financing conditions.
